good_thing: (Raja Ampat, Indonesia): Georgia Aquarium staff recently witnessed aquarium-bred zebra shark pups enter protected waters as part of the StAR Project. Each pup is tagged so researchers can follow its movement and survival. The project released 50 pups in 2025, reaching its annual goal for the first time, and hopes to sustain that pace for a decade.
current_or_history: On August 25, 1989, Voyager 2 made its closest pass over Neptune’s north pole, about 3,408 miles above the planet. Five hours later it flew past Triton, where its images revealed dark, geyser-like eruptions through nitrogen ice. The encounter came after 12 years of travel from its 1977 launch.
tiny_fact: Sea otters have loose folds of skin beneath their forearms that work like pockets. They can stash food there, and sometimes a favored rock for cracking hard-shelled prey while floating on their backs.
thought: Not every useful thing needs to happen quickly to be real.
